io.github.milisp.mcp-linker.fullDescription: Build, run, and test iOS and macOS apps with Xcode and the Simulator. Formerly XcodeBuildMCP, by Sentry. Requires macOS 14.5+ and Xcode 16+. Sends error reports to Sentry by default; see its README to opt out.
